sentences.text: Heard Ms. Divya Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.
None appears for the complainant.

The present second bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C.
apprehending his arrest in Case Crime No.37 of 2019, under Sections 354, 354-C, 506, 376 I.P.C.,
Section 66 of the Information Technology Act and Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act, P.S. Gudamba,
Anil Shukla @ Pintoo (Second Bail) vs State Of Up Thru.

entities.text: Anil Shukla @ Pintoo (Second Bail) vs State Of Up Thru
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. ...

on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165510649/
1 District Lucknow.

It is alleged in the prosecution case that accused-Anil Shukla @ Pintoo has friendly relationship with the son of the complainant and thereafter, he started visiting the house of the complainant and developed intimacy with the minor daughter of the complainant aged about 16 years, he then snapped some photographs of her for defaming the daughter of complainant by uploading her photographs.
Upon being advised, the applicant has threatened the complainant and his family members.
This incident is going on for last one and a half year.

Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant is languishing in jail since 18.07.2019,
statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded before the learned trial court and there is no apprehension of tampering with the evidence, there is delay of one and a half year in lodging the F.I.R., there is no allegation of rape in the F.I.R. and in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.

After six months precisely on 12.07.2019 when the statement of prosecutrix was recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the allegation of rape has been leveled for the first time, no date of incident has been mentioned in the F.I.R.

Since there is improvement in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. therefore, the statement does not inspires confidence and it needs further corroboration, no corroborative material in form of medical report or any independent witness is present in this case.

Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer and submits that allegation of uploading the photographs have been found and that is why charge-sheet has been filed under Section 66 of the Information Technology Act, rebutting the same learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant himself has filed this photographs and a perusal of the same shows that they were having relationship however, the photographs were not obscene.

It is further submitted that even as per the school record, the prosecutrix was more than 16 years at the time of lodging of the F.I.R.
On due consideration to the submissions advanced, perusal of the record so also the fact that statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. have been recorded after six months without there being any explanation by the prosecution and the statement of the prosecution story in the F.I.R., in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and Section 164 Cr.P.C. is not consistent and there is no corroborative evidence so also the fact

that applicant is languishing in jail since 18.07.2019,
applicant further undertakes to cooperate in the trial, it would be expedient in the interest of justice that the liberty of the applicant may be protected in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, since, charge-sheet in the matter has been filed, the accused applicant-Anil Shukla @ Pintoo is directed to surrender before trial court, if he is summoned to face trial for offence in question.
